parts.answer: For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD (also noted as 25 mg once daily), the maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring is recheck 2-4 weeks. Renal dosing by eGFR category is as follows: Normal (>=90): starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, monitoring routine; Mild (60-89): starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, monitoring routine; Severe (15-29): starting dose specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, monitoring enhanced. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21.
